name: celiador-ai
description: Celiador's AI layer — chat and agent, wired to the Celiador daemon.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, workspace settings cannot change where Celiador sends your credentials or prompts (daemon/sign-in URLs, provider, API key, Jev) or turn on auto-approved writes. Unless `celiador.autoApproveEdits` is enabled in your user settings, every write is confirmed before it is applied.

celiador.daemonUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL of the Celiador daemon the AI layer talks to. Leave empty to use this build's default (`celiadorDaemonUrl` in `product.json`): prod → `https://celiador.ai`, staging → `https://staging.celiador.ai`, dev → `http://localhost:4661`.

celiador.supabaseUrl.markdownDescription: Override the Supabase/GoTrue base URL used for sign-in. Leave empty to use the value from the daemon's `GET /api/config` (self-hosted defaults to the daemon URL).

celiador.token.markdownDescription: Optional shared-secret fallback for the daemon agent endpoint (`CELIADOR_AGENT_TOKEN`). Normally leave empty and sign in with **Celiador: Sign In** — your Supabase session is used instead.

celiador.provider.markdownDescription: Where the agent runs. `anthropic`: call Claude directly (needs an API key). `daemon`: route through the Celiador daemon (`celiador.daemonUrl`) with your **Celiador: Sign In** session (or `celiador.token` as a shared-secret fallback) — no client-side API key; the daemon holds the credential and picks the model. User-level only.

celiador.apiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key for `anthropic` provider (fallback). Prefer the **Celiador: Set API Key** command, which stores it in the OS keychain via SecretStorage. Resolution order: SecretStorage → this setting → `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`.

celiador.autoApproveEdits.description: Apply the agent's file writes without asking. When off (default), each write to a new/changed path requires confirmation. User-level only — a workspace can't turn this on.

celiador.model.description: Claude model the agent uses with the `anthropic` provider (the daemon picks its own model).

celiador.effort.description: Reasoning effort for the agent (higher = more thorough, more tokens).

celiador.jev.enabled.markdownDescription: **Experimental.** Use Jev (TypeSafe AI) for fast typed decisions around the agent loop. Needs a key via **Celiador: Set Jev API Key** or `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`. Any Jev failure falls back to normal behavior.

celiador.jev.routeEffort.markdownDescription: When Jev is enabled, pick the reasoning effort per task instead of always using `celiador.effort` (which remains the fallback). Only applies to the `anthropic` provider.

celiador.jev.classifyOutcome.markdownDescription: When Jev is enabled, classify how each turn ended. If the agent is waiting on you, the companion phone gets a question/“needs you” state instead of “Task finished”.

celiador.jev.minConfidence.description: Minimum Jev confidence required to act on a decision; below it the default behavior is kept.
